section.content: In a semiconductor integrated circuit constructed by thin film transistors (TFTs), an invertor circuit or a NAND circuit is formed by arranging a transmission gate circuit, a P-channel type TFT or an N-channel type TFT between a circuit including at least one P-channel type TFT and a circuit including at least one N-channel type TFT. The N-channel type TFT is earthed. Voltage drop produces by the arranged transmission gate circuit or P-channel or N-channel type TFT, so that the drain voltage of the earthed N-channel type TFT is decreased and an electric field near the drain region of the N-channel type TFT is decreased.
在由薄膜晶体管(TFTS)构成的半导体集成电路中，通过在至少包括一个P-沟型TFT的电路和至少包括一个N-沟型TFT的电路之间设置传输门电路，P-沟道型TFT或者N-沟道型TFT构成非门， 或与非门电路。N-沟道型TFT接地。用设置的传输门电路，或P-沟道或N-沟道型TFT产生电压降，因而，减少了接地的N-沟道型TFT的漏电压，并使N-沟道型TFT的漏区附近的电场减弱。

Film semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to prevent the high reliability film semiconductor integrated circuit of N-channel-type thin-film transistor (TFT) deterioration.

Background technology

As shown in Figure 4, connect the drain electrode of P-channel-type thin-film transistor (TFT) 401 and the drain electrode of N-channel-type TFT402 and constitute "NOT" circuit.In this state, big electric current flows into the drain electrode of N-channel-type TFT402.

As shown in Figure 5, if the drain voltage height of N-channel-type TFT402, the electronics in the gate electrode of N-channel-type TFT402 is captured to receive in the oxide-film as dielectric film in contiguous drain region, thereby, form weak P-type district in the interface portion between drain region and channel formation region.This has prevented the leakage current among the N-channel-type TFT402.Thereby, require VDS will increase than normal condition, as shown in Figure 6, and the thickness of the channel formation region of N-channel-type TFT402 increases.To reduce the influence in weak P-type district.

As a result, TFT compares with the P-channel-type, and the characteristic of N-channel-type TFT changes easily and worsens.Therefore, characteristic degradation has reduced the reliability of film semiconductor integrated circuit.At other basic circuit, for example in NAND gate (NAND) circuit, this is identical.That is, similar with "NOT" circuit, the N-channel-type TFT of ground connection worsens easily.

As mentioned above, when drain voltage is high, produce highfield (high strength is arranged) around the drain region, thereby, weak P-type district in channel formation region, formed.Thereby prevented leakage current.Therefore, with P-channel TFT ratio, the characteristic of N-channel-type TFT worsens easily.

Summary of the invention

The objective of the invention is to address the above problem.

Shown in Figure 1A, constitute "NOT" circuit with thin-film transistor (TFT), between P-channel-type TFT101 and N-channel-type TFT103, transmission gate circuit 102 is set.Thereby transmission gate circuit 102 produces voltage drop, and near the electric field the drain region of N-channel-type TFT103 weakens, to prevent characteristic degradation.

As shown in Figure 3A, in the "NOT" circuit that constitutes with TFT, between P-channel-type TFT301 and N-channel-type TFT302, be provided with N-channel-type TFT303 and P-channel-type TFT304, thereby, near the electric field in drain region that N-channel-type TFT303 and P-channel-type TFT304 produce voltage drop N-channel-type TFT302 weakens, to prevent characteristic degradation.

And, shown in Fig. 3 C, in the "NOT" circuit that TFT constitutes, between P-channel-type TFT301 and N-channel-type TFT302, N-channel-type TFT306 is set, thereby N-channel-type TFT306 produces voltage drop, near the drain region of N-channel-type TFT302 electric field weakens, to prevent characteristic degradation.

In addition, shown in Fig. 2 A, when the electrode grounding of the source of the N-channel-type TFT203 in the NAND circuit that constitutes with TFT, the drain electrode of N-channel-type 203 is connected the generation voltage drop with N-channel-type TFT204 with P-channel-type TFT205, near the drain region of the N-channel-type TFT203 of ground connection electric field weakens, to prevent characteristic degradation.

1. semiconductor integrated circuit comprises:</claim-text>A "NOT" circuit that comprises first and second thin-film transistors,</claim-text>Wherein said the first film transistor is the P-channel thin-film transistor, and described second thin-film transistor is the N-channel thin-film transistor,</claim-text>The transistorized source electrode of wherein said the first film is connected to first power supply terminal of described "NOT" circuit,</claim-text>Wherein said the first film transistor drain is connected to the lead-out terminal of described "NOT" circuit,</claim-text>The source electrode of wherein said second thin-film transistor is connected to the second source terminal of described "NOT" circuit,</claim-text>The drain electrode of wherein said second thin-film transistor is connected to the source electrode of the 3rd thin-film transistor, and the 3rd thin-film transistor is the N-channel thin-film transistor,</claim-text>The drain electrode of wherein said the 3rd thin-film transistor is connected to the described lead-out terminal of described "NOT" circuit,</claim-text>The current potential that wherein is applied to described second source terminal is lower than the current potential that is applied to described first power supply terminal, and</claim-text>Each grid of wherein said first, second and the 3rd thin-film transistor is connected to an input terminal of described "NOT" circuit.</claim-text>
